verdict.rationale: Circle documents parts of this story without showing a dedicated conversion API. Circle Mint lets qualified businesses convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost, and USDC and EURC are documented as redeemable 1:1, which a community comment corroborates as par with no fees. CPN offers real-time FX quotes with USDC settlement and near-instant 24/7 movement, and the CLI mentions swaps. Missing for 10: documented quote and execute endpoints for fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, explicit stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion (e.g. USDC↔EURC) with rate and fee schedules, documented settlement times for Mint conversions, and broad access beyond qualified businesses.
